purpose: Source-audited facts for unpublished 1.0(1); legal review required

facts.verified_value: iPhone, portrait, iOS 26.0 minimum; 1.0 (1); com.wisdommedium.alarm; Live Activity extension com.wisdommedium.alarm.widgets
facts.notes: Compiled Debug simulator verified; final device Release binary audit follows in Stage 07. iOS 26 runtime/device coverage pending.

facts.planned_value: Alarm labels, times, repeat, locks, sounds; timer; stopwatch/laps; preferences
facts.verified_value: SwiftData alarms (labels, times, weekdays, locks, sound, system IDs and delivery state); UserDefaults preferences/timer/journals/coarse point; protected JSON stopwatch/laps and weather. No app sync.
facts.notes: Deleting alarms first cancels delivery, with five-second in-memory undo. Stopwatch reset removes active saved laps; timer cancellation clears local session after native cancellation. Legacy import sources preserved. Uninstall/Apple backups not guaranteed to erase all historical copies.

facts.planned_value: None developer-managed; weather may call Apple
facts.verified_value: No developer backend, accounts, CloudKit sync, advertising, analytics or third-party packages in project. Optional Apple Weather fetch/attribution/logo network requests; explicit browser links and voluntary email.
facts.notes: Manifest declares no tracking/collected data and UserDefaults CA92.1. This is not a guarantee about Apple diagnostics, App Store services, backups or external mail/browser providers. App Store privacy questionnaire needs owner review.

facts.planned_value: Optional approximate location used for Apple Weather forecasts
facts.verified_value: Optional when-in-use one-shot location, desired accuracy 3 km; rounded to 0.1 degree before persistence and Apple Weather request; recent coarse point reused for six hours. No continuous/background location mode.
facts.notes: System may initially return a finer point, transient only. Rounding is not anonymity. Foreground return is local-only. Revocation clears cached point/forecast; physical permission checks pending.

facts.planned_value: Locally persisted/shared, expiry and off/on behavior to verify
facts.verified_value: Shared local schema-2 forecast with timestamps, expiry, hourly and solar values, rounded point and provider attribution. Expiry is earlier of provider expiry and 24h. Routine success refresh policy is 24h per location; one extra off/on attempt per local day, bounded retries.
facts.notes: OFF hides immediately/stops new requests; keeps bounded cache until expiry cleanup when app runs. Revocation purges forecast and point. Attempt metadata/manual-day history retained locally; old legacy policy files preserved. No continuous deletion process while terminated. Tests use injected data, not live provider observations.

facts.planned_value: AlarmKit when authorized; notification fallback when possible, not equivalent
facts.verified_value: Native AlarmKit registration verified via system query; permission-only failure can use registered local notifications if alert/sound allowed. Notifications explicitly labeled lower reliability. Timer and test alarm require native authorization.
facts.notes: Source and fake-backend tests verified; locked/Silent/Focus/force-quit speaker delivery pending by user instruction. Saved record alone never proves scheduled delivery.

facts.planned_value: Original or properly licensed sound assets, sirens and ice-cream melody
facts.verified_value: System alarm sound provided by Apple; sixteen custom original synthesized masters, plus sixteen gated seven-step prototypes. New ice-cream motif composed in generator; no borrowed recordings/melodies.
facts.notes: Provenance/generator/hash evidence verified, not a legal opinion or exclusivity guarantee. Owner reviews rights before publication.

facts.planned_value: 7 stages, optional, only claim if real AlarmKit/background behavior proven
facts.verified_value: Unavailable and disabled in this version. Prototype envelopes packaged but no verified system-delivery claim.
facts.notes: AlarmKit exposes named/default AlertSound, no dynamic gain API. Physical seven-step proof deferred; no advertising Progressive or system-volume override.

facts.planned_value: Provider mark and legal sources link available where required
facts.verified_value: Provider-returned combined mark and legal data-source link displayed with cached forecast; dedicated Settings attribution route and official legal sources link.
facts.notes: Logo fetched with AsyncImage; text placeholder while unavailable. Live provider logo/locale and offline presentation need device verification. WeatherKit terms: https://developer.apple.com/weatherkit/ ; sources: https://weatherkit.apple.com/legal-attribution.html
